big(bald_eagle). % s0
nice(bald_eagle). % s1
needs(bald_eagle, lion). % s2
visits(bald_eagle, lion). % s3
visits(bald_eagle, tiger). % s4
kind(dog). % s5
nice(dog). % s6
visits(dog, bald_eagle). % s7
eats(lion, bald_eagle). % s8
eats(lion, tiger). % s9
visits(lion, tiger). % s10
eats(tiger, bald_eagle). % s11
eats(tiger, dog). % s12
eats(tiger, lion). % s13
eats(X, dog) :- eats(X, dog), visits(X, lion). % s14
visits(X, bald_eagle) :- eats(X, lion). % s15
eats(bald_eagle, lion) :- nice(X), visits(X, bald_eagle). % s16
-cold(X) :- nice(X), visits(X, tiger). % s17
eats(dog, lion) :- needs(X, dog), needs(X, tiger). % s18
needs(X, tiger) :- visits(X, bald_eagle). % s19
eats(dog, lion) :- visits(X, dog), kind(X). % s20
needs(bald_eagle, dog) :- eats(bald_eagle, lion), -cold(bald_eagle). % s21
nice(lion) :- eats(dog, lion). % s22
?- -visits(bald_eagle, tiger). % s23
